checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Both hands and entire blue sheet visible on wooden table
must.why: Frames 2-4 show both hands and the whole sheet on wood. Frame 1 has the sheet held up in the air, not on the table.

must.item: Hands visibly bring one half over the other, producing a folded sheet, not abrupt replacement
must.why: Frame 1 shows the sheet held up in landscape. Frame 2 shows a flat portrait sheet with a crease already present. No fold is seen and the sheet looks as large as an unfolded sheet, so the change looks like a cut or replacement.

must.item: Hands press along the crease after folding
must.why: In frames 3-4 the hands rest flat below the crease line. They do not press or slide along it.

must.item: Hands anatomically plausible with convincing contact
must.why: Frames 3-4 show hands with five fingers each and natural contact. Frame 2 shows the left hand motion-blurred.

must.item: Blue paper remains a single consistent object
must.why: The sheet changes shape and orientation between frame 1 and frame 2. A small tab or notch appears at the left edge of the crease in frame 3.

must.item: 8s widescreen, one fixed overhead shot, no sound
must.why: The format is widescreen with a top-down view. Frame 1 is tilted and held up, and the framing differs from frames 2-4, so it may not be one fixed shot. Sound cannot be checked from the frames.

faults.what: No real fold is shown. A creased sheet appears between frame 1 and frame 2, and its size does not shrink to half.
The sheet changes orientation and size from frame 1 to frame 2, so it looks like an abrupt object change.
The hands never press the crease flat. They only rest below it.
A small paper tab or glitch appears at the left end of the crease in frame 3.
Frame 1 is held up in the air and tilted, not lying on the table. This conflicts with a fixed overhead shot.

summary: The clip is a realistic overhead shot of hands on a blue sheet on a wooden table, but it never shows the fold or the crease being pressed, and the sheet changes abruptly between frames.
